title: Write a short board-dispatch test report and post it as a comment
description: Disposable real-board smoke-test task for the containerized Issue Router. Read the parent epic description, write a concise report of the safe multi-worker dispatch goals in 3 short paragraphs, and post those exact paragraphs as a comment on this issue using the router result issue_comments field. Do not modify source code, documentation, issue files, or any other board issue. Do not claim that integration tests passed; this task only verifies real issue dispatch and comment publication. A human will review the comment and close the task after the router run.

comments.author: Kanbus Issue Router
comments.text:
This smoke test covers the real-board dispatch path for one bounded Kanbus package: a routed worker receives an isolated worktree, an explicit claim, and a logical revision, then may act only on the package's issue IDs. The package boundary prevents a worker from changing unrelated issues, while durable router state preserves the claim and checkpoint context needed for recovery.

Safe multi-worker dispatch depends on deterministic planning, WIP limits, lease or claim fencing, and revision-checked publication. Soft Git or MQTT coordination can race, so newer claims must reject stale checkpoints and results; hard Mutex API coordination must prevent a weaker provider from starting work when the lease is unavailable. Each accepted transition, comment, checkpoint, and artifact reference must remain auditable in router state.

This report verifies only that the router dispatched this disposable task to an isolated worker and that the requested comment payload is ready for canonical publication on the target issue. It does not claim that integration tests passed, that a live multi-worker harness ran, or that broader repository validation succeeded; those checks are outside this smoke test.
